```{R}
#master counties
usa <- state.name %>% 
  toupper()

length(usa)

```
```{R}
years <- 2003: 2023

```

```{r}
#LRP education workshop by state

education1 <- expand.grid(year = years, state = usa) %>% 
  mutate(state = as.character(state))

education2 <- read_excel("education.xlsx", sheet = 1)

education3 <- education1 %>% 
  left_join(education2, by = c("year", "state")) %>% 
  mutate(workshop = ifelse(is.na(workshop), 0, workshop),
                           projects = ifelse(is.na(projects), 0, projects))%>% 
  mutate(
    dollar.on.workshop = ifelse(workshop == 0 & is.na(dollar.on.workshop), 0, dollar.on.workshop),
    dollar.per.workshop = ifelse(workshop == 0 & is.na(dollar.per.workshop), 0, dollar.per.workshop)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(state) %>% 
  mutate(cumedu = cumsum(workshop)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(year, state) %>% 
  mutate(yn.education = ifelse(workshop > 0, 1, 0)) %>% 
   mutate(workshop = ifelse(is.na(workshop),0, workshop)) %>% 
  ungroup()


```



```{r}
#SOB by state 

sob1 <- read_excel("sobstate.xlsx", sheet = 2) %>% 
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year))




# 
sob2 <- expand.grid(year = years, state = usa) %>%
  mutate(state = as.character(state)) %>%
  left_join(sob1, by = c("year", "state")) %>% 
  mutate(cost.per.head = tot.premium / insured.head)




```


```{r}
#feeder cattle

feed <- read_excel("eliotfeeder.xlsx", sheet =1)


#herd size


herd.size <- read_excel("herdsize.xlsx") %>% 
  mutate(herd.size = ceiling(herd.size))

#sob 


sob3 <- sob2 %>% 
  left_join(feed, by = c("year", "state")) %>% 
  mutate(liability.by.feedercattle = liability/feeder) %>% 
  mutate(insuredhead.by.feedercattle = insured.head/feeder) %>% 
  mutate(insuredhead.by.feedercattle = ifelse(policy.earningprem == 0, 0, insuredhead.by.feedercattle)) %>% 
    mutate(liability.by.feedercattle = ifelse(policy.earningprem == 0, 0, liability.by.feedercattle)) %>% 
  left_join(herd.size, by = c("year", "state")) %>% 
  mutate(market.share.producer = policy.earningprem/operation) %>% 
    mutate(insuredhead.by.feedercattle = ifelse(policy.earningprem == 0, 0, insuredhead.by.feedercattle))

  

#CME feeder cattle index

index <- read_excel("volatilityfeeder.xlsx", sheet = 1) %>% 
  distinct(year, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  rename(cattle.index = avg.index,
         SD = std.index)

# Create a data frame with years from 2003 to 2023
base <- data.frame(year = 2003:2023) %>%
  mutate(
    base.subsidy = case_when(
      year >= 2003 & year <= 2019 ~ 13,
      year == 2020 ~ 20,
      year > 2020 ~ 35
    )
  )

#LRP availability 

avail <- read_excel("lrp_availability.xlsx") %>% 
  mutate(state =toupper(state)) %>% 
  arrange(state)


#with education

sob.price.edu <- education3 %>% 
  left_join(sob3, by = c("year", "state")) %>% 
  left_join(index, by = "year") %>% 
  left_join(avail, by = c("year", "state")) %>% 
  left_join(base, by = "year")

```




```{R}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)

original <- sob.price.edu %>% 
  mutate(across(-c(year, state, policy.sold, base.subsidy, projects, workshop, dollar.on.workshop, dollar.per.workshop, cumedu, cattle.index, SD, price, herd.size, operation, eligibility), 
                  ~ ifelse(policy.earningprem == 0, 0, .))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(year, state, policy.sold, policy.earningprem, market.share.producer, insuredhead.by.feedercattle, cost.per.head, liability.by.feedercattle, cattle.index, SD, projects, workshop, dollar.on.workshop, dollar.per.workshop, cumedu, base.subsidy, herd.size, eligibility) 



eligible.dataset <- original %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    year, state, policy.sold, policy.earningprem, market.share.producer, 
    insuredhead.by.feedercattle, cost.per.head, liability.by.feedercattle, 
    cattle.index, SD, projects, workshop, dollar.on.workshop, dollar.per.workshop,
    cumedu, base.subsidy, herd.size, eligibility
  ) %>% 
  filter(eligibility == 1) %>%   # scaling issues
  mutate(
    workshop = workshop * 10,
    projects = projects*10,
    herd.size = herd.size,
    sq.herd.size = herd.size^2,
    
    # Replace NA in policy.earningprem with 0
    policy.earningprem = ifelse(is.na(policy.earningprem), 0, policy.earningprem),
    
    # Set corresponding values to 0 when policy.earningprem == 0
    policy.sold = ifelse(policy.earningprem == 0, 0, policy.sold),
    market.share.producer = ifelse(policy.earningprem == 0, 0, market.share.producer),
    insuredhead.by.feedercattle = ifelse(policy.earningprem == 0, 0, insuredhead.by.feedercattle),
    liability.by.feedercattle = ifelse(policy.earningprem == 0, 0, liability.by.feedercattle),
    cost.per.head = ifelse(policy.earningprem == 0, 0, cost.per.head))



#adding trend

#time trend

eligible.dataset$trend <- eligible.dataset$year - 2003 + 1


```


```{r}
#adding state trend

library(dplyr)

eligible.dataset <- eligible.dataset %>%
  arrange(state, year) %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  mutate(trend_state = year - min(year) + 1) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{R}
#packages 

library(dplyr)
library(margins)
library(MASS)
library(pscl)
library(sandwich)


#dataset preparation 


#pilot state 

pilot <- c("COLORADO", "IOWA", "KANSAS", "NEBRASKA", "NEVADA", 
           "OKLAHOMA", "SOUTH DAKOTA", "TEXAS", "UTAH", "WYOMING")

data.pilot <- eligible.dataset %>% 
  filter(state %in% pilot)



#non-pilot state 

nonpilot <- c("COLORADO", "IOWA", "KANSAS", "NEBRASKA", "NEVADA", 
           "OKLAHOMA", "SOUTH DAKOTA", "TEXAS", "UTAH", "WYOMING")

data.nonpilot <- eligible.dataset %>% 
  filter(!state %in% pilot)



#pre 2020

pre2020.pool <- eligible.dataset %>% 
  dplyr::filter(year<2020) 
  



pre2020.nonpilot <- pre2020.pool %>% 
  filter(!state %in% pilot)


pre2020.pilot <- pre2020.pool %>% 
  filter(state%in%pilot)


#year 2020


pool.2020 <- eligible.dataset %>% 
  dplyr::filter(year==2020)


nonpilot.2020 <- pool.2020 %>% 
  filter(!state %in% pilot)


pilot.2020 <- pool.2020 %>% 
  filter(state %in% pilot)





#post 2020

post2020.pool <- eligible.dataset %>% 
  filter(year>2020) 


post2020.nonpilot <- post2020.pool %>% 
  filter(!state%in%pilot)

post2020.pilot <- post2020.pool %>% 
  filter(state%in%pilot)


```


```{R}
#count of purchase rate 

library(dplyr)

purchase_stats <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    summarise(
      observations = n(),
      positive_count = sum(policy.earningprem > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      purchase_rate = positive_count / observations
    )
}

# pre 2020
purchase_stats(pre2020.pool)
purchase_stats(pre2020.pilot)
purchase_stats(pre2020.nonpilot)

# year 2020
purchase_stats(pool.2020)
purchase_stats(pilot.2020)
purchase_stats(nonpilot.2020)

# post 2020
purchase_stats(post2020.pool)
purchase_stats(post2020.pilot)
purchase_stats(post2020.nonpilot)

```

```{R}
#extensive margin 
#pooled sample: producer market share

library(dplyr)
library(lmtest)



data.extensive.pool.producer <- eligible.dataset %>%
  mutate(market.share.producer = ifelse(market.share.producer > 0, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(lag.lrp = lag(market.share.producer, 1))


logit.pool.producer <- glm(market.share.producer ~ cattle.index + SD + base.subsidy +
                   herd.size + sq.herd.size + trend* workshop,
                   data = data.extensive.pool.producer, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

summary(logit.pool.producer)

# Compute clustered standard errors by 'state'
cluster_se <- vcovCL(logit.pool.producer, cluster = ~state)

# Clustered coefficient test
coeftest(logit.pool.producer, vcov. = cluster_se)



#marginal effect 

library(margins)

margins(logit.pool.producer)

#llk

logLik(logit.pool.producer)


```

```{R}
#libraries for logit and tidy
```

```{R}

#extensive margin (2003-2023)


data.extensive.pool.producer <- eligible.dataset %>%
  mutate(market.share.producer = ifelse(market.share.producer > 0, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(lag.lrp = lag(market.share.producer, 1))






#workshop

model1 <- glm(market.share.producer ~ cattle.index + SD  +
                herd.size + sq.herd.size + trend*workshop,
              data = data.extensive.pool.producer,
              family = binomial(link = "logit"))

#clustering by state

cluster_se <- vcovCL(model1, cluster = ~state)

# Clustered coefficient test
coeftest(model1, vcov. = cluster_se)


#marginal effects 

margins(model1)



```

```{R}

#marginal effect at mean

margins(fractional.pool.producer)
```

```{R}
  separate(col = model, into = c("stage", "years", "DV", "type", "IV"), sep = " ", remove = FALSE)
print(all.models.procured)
```

```{r}
#combining producer and product market share

library(readxl)
producer <- read_excel("results_producermarketshareallmodels.xlsx")

product <- read_excel("results_productmarketshareallmodels.xlsx")

combined <- bind_rows(producer, product)

print(combined)

#download
library(writexl)

write_xlsx(combined, "results_producerandproduct.xlsx")
```

```{R}
#pre 2019 
#intensive margin
#producer market share
#non-pilot states 


pre2019data.intensive.nonpilot.producer <- pre2019.nonpilot %>%
filter(market.share.producer>0)

#fractional producer
pre2019.fractional.nonpilot.producer <-glm(market.share.producer ~ cattle.index + SD + workshop * base.subsidy +
                   herd.size + sq.herd.size + trend,
  data = pre2019data.intensive.nonpilot.producer,
  family = quasibinomial (link = "logit")
)

summary(pre2019.fractional.nonpilot.producer)

# Compute clustered standard errors by 'state'
cluster_se <- vcovCL(pre2019.fractional.nonpilot.producer, cluster = ~state)

# Clustered coefficient test
coeftest(pre2019.fractional.nonpilot.producer, vcov. = cluster_se)

#marginal value 

margins(pre2019.fractional.nonpilot.producer)

```
